datasets.title: Liechtenstein: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: The world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in Liechtenstein: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/liechtenstein-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates]
datasets.details: To reference this data, please use the following citation: Facebook Connectivity Lab and Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University. 2016. High Resolution Settlement Layer (HRSL). Source imagery for HRSL © 2016 DigitalGlobe. Accessed DAY MONTH YEAR.' Please note that as of 2024, Meta's high resolution population density maps are no longer being updated.

creator.name: AI and Data for Good at Meta

lineage.description: High-resolution population density maps were generated by applying machine learning algorithms to identify building footprints from commercial satellite imagery, then overlaying population estimates derived from publicly available census data and demographic statistics. The resulting gridded datasets provide spatial distribution of total population and demographic subgroups (age, sex, reproductive age) across Liechtenstein.

sources.name: AI and Data for Good at Meta
sources.description: Machine learning-based building identification from satellite imagery combined with census-based population estimation to generate high-resolution population density maps

sources.description: Population estimation methodology and census data integration for demographic disaggregation
